title: dfd@1 — a source-independent data flow diagram model (lib/dfd.mjs)
description: Three element kinds (process, store, external) and flows between them. A broker or queue is a store with subtype broker|queue|topic|stream|log. Referential integrity (unique ids, flow endpoints, declared layers and groups, which kind takes which subtype, v as the first field) is checked in code by validateDfd, not here. Every field added after the first release is optional, so a document written before it stays valid.

subtype.description: store: broker|queue|topic|stream|log (a broker: data waits in it between writer and reader) or database|file. external: endpoint (a network peer or a listening port), scheduler (launchd, a workflow schedule, cron, a timer, a watcher), actor (a person or an attacker), system (another program), env (configuration from outside), binary (an executable spawned by name). A process takes none. Which kind takes which is checked in validateDfd.

role.description: What the flow carries. Absent is data. feedback, error and retry are return paths: analysis classes them as feedback even when the opposite flow is adjacent, and only data flows collapse into a two-way pair.

existence.description: The producer's verdict on whether the flow is real: confirmed only when a second witness (the runtime, for the flow-graph adapter) agreed. Distinct from evidence.existence, which is the source edge's own value carried unchanged.

direction.description: On a flow made from an undirected touch, what the runtime saw the module do: reads (the flow runs into the module), writes (out of it) or both (two flows, one each way). Present only when the runtime resolved it; such a flow is directed.
